Galamoth gains an additional hidden

every 8 levels, up to a max of 6 at level 40, without taking up any weapon slots; the actual weapon can still be obtained from level-up choices, allowing the player to have a total of 7 Lightning Rings. After that, each of the hidden weapons is upgraded after every 12 levels, 7 times, up to level 124, where all rings reach their maximum level at level 8; however, they do not gain Limit Break bonuses. The hidden Lightning Rings also fire whenever the character takes any form of damage.
Galamoth starts out massive, but upon reviving shrinks to a more reasonable size on screen.
Galamoth can find special Ode to Castlevania pickups from light sources.
Despite the size of Galamoth's sprite, his actual hitbox is just the same as any normal character's. This also means that, despite his unlock description, he can, somehow, fit through normal doors.

, as he is also a massive enemy whose size causes him to appear larger than the screen.
Him starting with Tenebris Tonitrus is a reference to his wide array of electrical attacks in Symphony of the Night.
